title: Baloch National Movement protests in Seattle over rights abuses in Balochistan

tea.why: The BNM accuses Pakistani forces of military operations and bombardments that harm Baloch civilians.
tea.want: The US should review its relations with Pakistan and make aid conditional on human rights in Balochistan.
tea.changed: Sept 27: BNM members held a poster protest in Seattle, reported by ANI and IANS on Oct 2.

summary: The Baloch National Movement (BNM) held a protest in Seattle, Washington, on September 27 to draw attention to alleged human rights abuses in Pakistan's Balochistan province. Protesters carried posters about military operations and bombardments, and speakers said Baloch civilians were being killed. They urged the US government to review its relationship with Pakistan and to make future assistance conditional on respect for human rights, and asked the American public to speak out. The reports are based on the BNM's own account; no crowd size is given.
demands: Review US relations with and aid to Pakistan
Make US support conditional on human rights in Balochistan
response: No response from US or Pakistani officials is reported in the sources.

updates.text: BNM members protested in Seattle with posters on military operations in Balochistan.

sources.title: Baloch group holds protest in Seattle, raises alarm over growing human rights abuses in Pakistan
